title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Navigator's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the verified return bearing; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
